contributor_notes: Source confirms a central explicit romance between Stede Bonnet and Ed Teach, praised for subverting queerbaiting, plus a nonbinary character (Jim Jimenez) and three queer relationships total. Creator David Jenkins pitched the show around the central relationship, but the source does not state his identity, so he is not listed as a queer creator. Specific labels (gay/bi) for Stede and Ed are not given in the source, so the queer umbrella is used. Izzy Hands is mentioned but not explicitly identified as queer. A third relationship is referenced but its participants are not named. Human maintainer should verify audio/subtitle availability and any additional cast details.
